inventory_limitations: The original parser emitted no BrowserType.* member entries. BrowserType appears as an export interface, but its methods and properties are missing from entries.

Recovered from types.d.ts (comment-stripped declaration parse): connectOverCDP, connect, executablePath, launch, launchPersistentContext, launchServer, name. Overloads were collapsed to one inventory row per member name.
Electron, Android, and nested option-object members may also be incomplete in the original parser output.

The original parser attached some nested option fields to parent types (for example Page.trial, Page.waitUntil, Browser.viewport). Those rows are preserved as parser output and are not treated as proof that the parent object has those fields.
EventEmitter overloads (on/once/off and related) are represented as events plus Page.addListener-style methods where the parser emitted them; types.d.ts recovery does not re-emit every overload.
Type-level inventory is necessary but not sufficient for compatibility. Schema presence does not imply source or behavior compatibility.
Oracle receipts exist only for scoped cases (setContent title/evaluate/innerText, native alert type/message, locator.fill). behavior:passing is those cases, not the 1,354-row Playwright surface.

status_vocabulary.unverified: The symbol is inventoried for the javascript-library/chromium surface, but Phase 0 has no implementation and no executed test.
status_vocabulary.unsupported: The symbol is inventoried for schema tracking or because the parser/types emitted it, but it is on a separate first-release track: @playwright/test, Electron, Android, CDP-as-compatibility-claim, actual Firefox/WebKit engine behavior, or arbitrary npm. Calls MUST fail explicitly. firefox/webkit launch MUST fail with browser_engine_not_available and MUST NOT silently launch Servo.
status_vocabulary.implemented: A Greppy web-runtime binding exists for this symbol. This is not a Playwright-compatibility claim.
status_vocabulary.passing: A named Greppy test executed the symbol. It is not an oracle comparison against playwright@1.62.1 + Chromium.
status_vocabulary.partial: Some inventoried symbols have bindings and tests; the rest remain unverified or unsupported. Oracle behavior is unverified until Phase 20 receipts exist.
status_vocabulary.phase_0_note: Phase 0 forbade implemented/passing/unknown because no runtime existed. Later phases may set implemented/passing in-place; unknown remains forbidden. Entries must not be deleted.
